claims.citation: New York Herald, 16 July 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Deal, July 1—Arr Pride of the Ocean (?), NYork, and sld
for London (the Pride of the Ocean, Kyle, cleared at NYork
June 21 for London, but she could not have reached there in
9 days);
